title: AgentEval suite definition manifest 1.0 (external to AEF)

inputs.description: At most 10,000 named exact input content digests (datasets, prompt material, code/rubric definitions), enforced by the reader. No raw prompt or dataset text is required.

definition.description: Producer-owned declared evaluation configuration, including thresholds, weighting, aggregation and trial/generation policies. No observed scores, durations or run IDs.

caseIds.description: Complete planned case roster, not observed results; order has no meaning here. Ordered case content belongs in the hashed inputs.
